instructions.pass: Unhelpful impulses or reactions to let pass

goodSituations.text: A friend calls to check in
You have a moment to rest
You feel ready for a walk
You have time for a break
You need a glass of water
You have a chance to sleep
You can take a deep breath
You have a moment of calm
You have an idea to try
You can start a small task
You have a chance to learn
You can make a small plan
You can say what you need
You can send a kind note
You can make time to listen
You can ask how they are
You can check on a friend

Make a joke at their cost
Turn a chat into a contest
Brag to make them feel bad
Treat a queue as an attack
Take a joke as a threat
Make a scene over a delay
React to a rumor as fact
Treat a glance as a warning
Look for flaws in every plan
Assume a late text is bad
Look for a catch in praise
Grab a snack out of boredom
Make a bet out of boredom

Refuse to ask how they are
Skip a small act of care
Treat your body as a tool
